data.one_liner: Provides customizable map themes and preset styles for map implementations.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that supplies built-in and custom map themes alongside persistence capabilities for user preferences. It offers widgets and managers to style map components dynamically, currently supporting Google Maps.
use_when: You want to easily add dark, night, or retro themes to Google Maps in Flutter.
You need automatic persistence for user map theme selections.
You want pre-built UI selectors for changing map styles.
avoid_when: You are using map engines other than Google Maps (currently unsupported by this plugin).
You require complex vector styling outside of standard map JSON styles.
strengths: Includes 5 built-in themes (Standard, Dark, Night, Night Blue, Retro).
Supports auto-persistence of user theme choices via shared_preferences.
Provides flexible usage patterns: all-in-one widget, separate selector, and programmatic manager.
weaknesses: Currently restricted to Google Maps implementation.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Google Maps API keys on Android and iOS following the standard google_maps_flutter platform setup guides.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer to implement manual map styling and custom JSON themes directly without an auxiliary theming package.
